lever.meaning: Hypothetical assumed master rate; never a claimed provider payout rate

steps: accepted annual streams × assumed Spotify rate
modeled annual gross × net factor × controlled-share assumption
numeric_policy: Existing estimate binary64 arithmetic; no interim rounding; parity tolerance relative1e-12/absolute1e-9
comparison_gate: Exact same cohort,365-day period,currency,master rights,Spotify-stream unit for every included record. Only measured_365d or explicitly unknown records; no conversion from cumulative or run-rate data in v1.
coverage: Retain original observations,source references,capture dates,coverage notes and null unknowns; subset status never expands to whole catalog.
ui_contract: Consume the canonical scripts/scenario.mjs module with an exact commit and byte hash; do not copy finance formulas into App. Python remains the conformance reference.
Persist/export full observations,baseline and scenario assumptions,method revision/hash and coverage. Context selection descriptors remain separately owned.
Reset uses null override to restore original baseline config; never writes modeled values into observations.
Label every monetary output hypothetical and distinguish source Spotify observations,other-platform assumptions and realized cash.
Missing compatible annual data means refusal or unknown; never repurpose daily or cumulative explorer fixtures.
remaining_integration: Catalog browser adapter is available; shared App and Context integration remain separately owned and reviewed. No model call, network endpoint, paid read, provider operation or new ingestion is implemented.

browser_adapter.requirements: ES modules, TextEncoder and Web Crypto in a secure context or localhost
browser_adapter.consumption: Pin exact Skills commit and module SHA-256; vendor byte-identically and check drift; see browser-scenario.md
